title: Persistent Task CRUD API
outcome: Build persistent task CRUD through controller → service → Prisma with explicit contracts and verified database effects.
artifact: Working /tasks API supporting create/list/read/update/delete against PostgreSQL with consistent error behavior.
labSteps: Define Task create/update/read response shapes before implementation.
Implement create through the service and verify both HTTP response and database row.
Implement list/read with deterministic ordering and missing-record behavior.
Implement partial update without overwriting omitted fields accidentally.
Implement delete semantics and decide whether the API returns the resource, metadata, or no content.
Run a manual CRUD script from empty database to cleanup and save it as a repeatable smoke test.
failureModes: PATCH treats omitted values as null/empty
Missing records bubble up as raw ORM exceptions
UI is considered proof without inspecting API/database
mastery: Can build CRUD without copy-paste controller logic
Can map persistence failures to API semantics
Can explain why response contracts should not be accidental Prisma types
principles: CRUD endpoints are complete only when data persists and failure cases are handled deliberately.
Keep database calls behind service methods so controllers remain thin and testable.
Return the created or updated resource contract consistently after successful mutations.
Verify persistence independently with API requests and database inspection instead of trusting only the UI.
